name: Unspoken Rituals
description: This is Unspoken rituals, a collaborative cooking, food-sharing performance. It is a collective digestion of thoughts, ideas, emotions and everything in between, the unspoken, the unexplainable, the shared experiences.
body:
**A collective digestion**

Hello dear human,

This is Unspoken Rituals, a collaborative cooking and food-sharing performance. 

Please write in the box below up to 100 characters that you would like us to eat together during a meal. Nobody, not even me, will know what you write.



When you click Send, I will receive only the number of each character I need to translate, along with your name and your email. For example, your text might have 5 N’s, 1 comma or 3 brackets. 

I will then translate the characters you send into pasta characters using a specific set of character-symbols. Finally, we will mix all our pasta characters, cook them and eat them together at a collective dinner.

\
Unspoken Rituals is a collective digestion of thoughts, ideas, emotions and everything in between: the unspoken, the unexplainable, the shared experiences. This ritual is about devotion, trust and hope. We trust that the people with whom we share food will nourish us.

The date, time and place of our dinner will be shared with you soon. Please bring a decorative object you would like to have at the dinner table.

Thank you for being part of Unspoken Rituals. See you at dinner.



With love,

Belen
